'''The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralizaton''' (also known as '''THORN''') was a philanthropic agency that sought to eradicate the [[rakghoul pandemic]]. The organization was created by the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] [[Addalar Hyland]], and was tasked with not only finding the cure for the [[Disease/Legends|plague]], but also the elimination of [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] infestations. [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] of the group were commonly called "Neutralizers," some of which were talented volunteers.<ref name="codex-THORN" />

During the outbreaks of [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], THORN, in cooperation with both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], initiated quarantine on the planets by dispatching armed personnel to block the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. The organization set up camps to act both as field hospitals to treat the infected and bases of operations,<ref name="Event">{{TORcite|type=other|Event: "Rakghoul Resurgence"}}</ref> from which they were hiring individuals to distribute the [[Rakghoul vaccine|vaccine]].<ref name="dialy">{{TORcite|type=daily|Quarantine|various planets}}</ref> From these camps THORN was also supplying their contractors with various THORN products and instructed the newcomers with what has to be done.<ref name="Event" />

On each of the three planets where the [[Rakghoul pandemic|pandemic]] broke out, a system of [[Rakghoul tunnels|underground tunnels]] through which [[Rakghoul|rakghouls]] kept coming was was discovered. In each case THORN traced the tunnels to the locations most convenient for intrusion, where a massive super-weapon known as the [[The Spike (weapon)|Spike]] was deployed, to penetrate the surface and allow access underground. The location of the Spike was connected with THORN camps via [[Speeder bike|speeder bike]] routs, and numerous brave contractors and volunteers, accompanied by fully armored THORN soldiers, descended into the tunnels to hold back the spread of rakghouls and conduct research for the organization.<ref name="Event" />
